set_findings.strongest_meaning: R3 connects expanding scope to the structure required to carry it.
set_findings.clearest_compact_delivery: R4, while still below the required standard in all five dimensions.
set_findings.main_gap: Observable detail with consequence: the benchmarks show how a note, extra version or stopping point changes the commitment.
set_findings.context_effect: Curiosity often appears beside the demanding role; chronology is usually appended or compressed. Neither consistently transforms a single scene.
set_findings.planet_keyword_lists: None present; named contacts mainly serve explanatory prose.
set_findings.reassurance_and_warmth: No strong reassurance excess. R2 uses general coaching language; much of the set lacks the precise observation that would earn warmth.

coverage_limits: The shared contact and setting are controlled comparison conditions, not evidence of consecutive-day repetition.

Broader contacts, natal lenses, transit chapters, settings and consecutive days are unestablished.
